lens.focal_length_mm: Multi-directional fixed modules: 2M (2.4/2.8/3.6/6/12mm) or 5M (3.7/4.6/7mm); PTZ: 4.44-142.6mm (32x optical zoom)

features: Multi-directional (4CH, exchangeable 2M/5M lens modules) + integrated 32x PTZ
150 dB WDR (2M module) / 120 dB WDR (5M module)
release_notes: Ingest 2026-09-08 (multi-directional + PTZ gap fill; discontinued, superseded by PNM-9322VQP). No official DataSheet PDF reachable in Hanwha's PIM and the product page's full spec table is JS-rendered; record built from the official product-details overview. Verified: multi-directional 4-channel body with exchangeable 2M or 5M fixed lens modules plus an integrated 32x-optical-zoom PTZ camera; total resolution 8-20MP depending on module configuration; H.265/H.264/MJPEG, max 60fps@2M / 30fps@5M, WDR 150dB (2M) / 120dB (5M), 5 SD slots, PoE, IP66/IK10. IR, minimum illumination, power figure, operating temperature, dimensions and weight were not machine-readable and are omitted (not fabricated). megapixels recorded as the maximum (20MP) configuration.

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.
